verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Father, we have come to bow down in worship
Lifting up our hearts, we bow down in prayer

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Alleluia, lover of our souls
Alleluia, with all of heaven we are singing

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Bright and morning star, Your eyes blaze like fire
Shining like the sun, You’re our one desire

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
All the angels cry out
Holy is the Lord
All the earth replies
Holy are You

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
Alleluia
Alleluia
Alleluia
Holy are You

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
King of glory
Have Your glory
King of glory
Have Your glory
